title: context-budget 300-line threshold structurally incompatible with skill markdown files
description: Both fix_signal.skill.md (~458 lines) and run.skill.md (593 lines) exceed the 300-line context-budget. These are workflow definition documents that cannot be split below 300 lines without kernel changes to support multi-file skill loading. The context-budget criterion was designed for Rust source files; applying it to skill markdown files causes systematic context-budget failures on every run that modifies a skill file.
proposed_resolution: Introduce a separate budget threshold for *.skill.md files (e.g., 600 lines), or exclude skill files from context-budget enforcement and add a separate skill-file-budget criterion with an appropriate threshold.
resolution_summary: Superseded by a1000063: consolidated prompt/README audit and MCP result overflow signal.
